warnings: Second of three pile-cap detail sheets (S-10/S-11/S-12). F6 is used at E2 and F9 at D1/D3/C1/C3/B1/B2 on S-03/หน้า30. The construction notes common to all six caps (pile dowel 1ø12มม.ยาว 1.00 ม., กรอกคอนกรีตลึก 0.50 ม., 0.05m head embedment, 0.10 คอนกรีต 1:3:5 over 0.05 ทราย, cap bottom 1.00m below ±0.00, 'ตอม่อดูขยายเสา' for the pedestal) are written out on S-10/หน้า37 and not repeated here.

F6 is the only rectangular (non-square) cap on this sheet: 1.30m x 0.85m, 6 piles in a 3x2 grid. Its mat is printed as TWO separate leaders, '7ø12มม.' and '5ø12มม.', not as a single 'n+nø12มม.#' — 7 bars run the long way and 5 the short way. Recorded as a main_bar total of 12 with the two directions itemised in bar_layers, rather than forcing it into the each-way form used for the square caps.
F9's plan chain reads 0.20|0.45|0.45|0.20 = 1.30 both ways with pile centres at the chain points (3x3 = 9 piles). F6's is 0.20|0.45|0.45|0.20 = 1.30 across and 0.20|0.225|0.225|0.20 = 0.85 deep.
Bar-type convention: ø9มม and smaller recorded as 'RB' (plain round), ø12มม and larger as 'DB' (deformed). The sheet prints only 'ø'.
